title: Start and end images
hint: An image model edits the pictures of the shot into a start image, an end image or both, that keep its characters and its set; or the shot takes the last frame of the previous shot as its start image and the first frame of the next one as its end image. Accept a candidate or retrieve a frame, then save the shot.

retrieve.reason.first: this is the first shot, there is no previous shot.
retrieve.reason.last: this is the last shot, there is no next shot.
retrieve.reason.empty: “{shot}” has no media and no take yet.
retrieve.reason.pendingNext: “{shot}” is being generated: retrieve its first frame once its take is done.
retrieve.previousState.ready: The last frame of “{shot}” becomes the start image.
retrieve.previousState.stale: The start image is the last frame of “{shot}”, out of date: “{shot}” changed since. Retrieve it again.
retrieve.previousState.current: The start image is already the last frame of “{shot}”.
retrieve.previousState.pending: “{shot}” is being generated: link this shot to it, and its last frame becomes the start image when its take ends (the take of this shot waits for it).
retrieve.previousState.linked: Linked: the start image will be the last frame of “{shot}” when its take ends.
retrieve.nextState.ready: The first frame of “{shot}” becomes the end image.
retrieve.nextState.start: The start image of “{shot}” becomes the end image.
retrieve.nextState.current: The end image is already the first frame of “{shot}”.
retrieve.chainOn: This also turns on “Start from the end of the previous shot” for this shot, the switch of Inspector › Frames.
retrieve.tookPrevious: Start image: the last frame of “{shot}”. Save the shot to keep it.
retrieve.tookNext: End image: the first frame of “{shot}”. Save the shot to keep it.
retrieve.tookNextStart: End image: the start image of “{shot}”. Save the shot to keep it.
retrieve.linked: The start image will be the last frame of “{shot}”. Save the shot to keep the link.
retrieve.error.noMedia: The shot has no video to take that frame from.
